text:
```yaml
name: eng-common-tsp-client-test

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/eng-common-tsp-client-test.yml
      - src/dotnet/eng-common/**
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/eng-common-tsp-client-test.yml
      - src/dotnet/eng-common/**

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v5
        with:
          dotnet-version: |
            8.0.x
            9.0.x

      - name: Restore dependencies
        run: dotnet restore

      - name: Build
        run: dotnet build --no-restore

      - name: Test
        run: dotnet test --no-build -v n

      - name: Run Python validation checks tests
        run: |
          dotnet test --no-build -v n --filter "PythonLanguageSpecificChecksTests"
```
